result.summary: Found 1 issue: corrupted/overlapping delivery time text in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery time text is visually broken, appearing as '25-35Drdelivery · Ramen' instead of the expected '25-35 min delivery · Ramen'. The 'min' abbreviation is missing or corrupted and merged into the word 'delivery', making the label look unprofessional and harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text rendering so the delivery time label reads clearly as '25-35 min delivery · Ramen', ensuring proper spacing between the time, unit, and delivery label.
